## Why

Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-203302-a88e for S586 (discovered from S586):

`go -C * test*` and `go -C * vet*` read-only entries have the same mid-pattern `*` problem
In the matcher model (`*` becomes `.*`), `Bash(go -C * test*)` matches `go -C /w get example.com/m test` and `go -C /w mod edit -droprequire=x test`. Both write go.mod from a read-only role. S586 deliberately left `go -C` alone (TestPinGitC keeps `Bash(go -C * test*)`). The fix would be to pin `go -C` the same way, or to add a negative test listing go write commands that end in `test` or `vet`. PLAUSIBLE: I traced this against the `.*` model but did not run it.
